featured.name: Official ATS Convoy - Boat show
featured.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul a boat to Yakima! 👀  

> The yearly Yakima Sprint Boat racing now has a new edition with a regular boat show that is being held at the end of November. For this we require several boats to being hauled to various companies in Yakima from their storage location in Wenatchee.

The event takes place on the **14th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P4sECCF_QEadR)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38596.1792995339.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul a boat  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Yakima.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/516fd848-53ae-41ba-9b78-7974591827c0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Wenatchee** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121346-official-ats-convoy-boat-show/)**!

today.rule:
1. 🔒 This is a public car-only convoy. Only passenger cars are allowed to participate; all trucks, trailers, freight vehicles and special vehicles are strictly prohibited from joining the convoy.
2. 📄 All participants must strictly abide by the official TruckersMP User Agreement, server code of conduct and online game rules.
3. 🚗 Maintain a constant slow speed and safe distance at all times. Speeding, ramming, drifting, reckless lane changes and forced overtaking are strictly forbidden.
4. 🎖️ Obey all arrangements and instructions from event organizers, convoy leaders and traffic marshals. Do not leave the team, take the lead or change lanes without permission.
5. ⚠️ Malicious road blocking, position hogging, cutting off other vehicles, colliding with teammates and other behaviors that disrupt the overall convoy order are strictly prohibited.
6. 🛑 Do not stop randomly or cut in line after disconnection during the drive. If temporary parking is needed, please signal in advance and stay away from the main convoy route.
7. 🤝 Respect every participant, drive politely and communicate friendly. Quarrels, spamming and malicious teasing that damage the event atmosphere are not allowed.
8. 🚫 Organizers reserve the right to remove players who violate event and server rules from the convoy immediately. Severe violations will be recorded and reported to TruckersMP officials for review and punishment.
9. ✅ All participants are requested to check game mods, game files and network status in advance to ensure smooth participation in this public convoy event.

upcoming.name: Official ATS Convoy - Boat show
upcoming.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul a boat to Yakima! 👀  

> The yearly Yakima Sprint Boat racing now has a new edition with a regular boat show that is being held at the end of November. For this we require several boats to being hauled to various companies in Yakima from their storage location in Wenatchee.

The event takes place on the **14th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P4sECCF_QEadR)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38596.1792995339.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul a boat  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Yakima.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/516fd848-53ae-41ba-9b78-7974591827c0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Wenatchee** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121346-official-ats-convoy-boat-show/)**!

upcoming.name: Першерон
upcoming.description:
### Описание мероприятия
![](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/cover/38866.1794243210.jpg)

Привет, друзья!
Снова рады видеть вас на нашем особо тяжелом мероприятии от ВТК Yukon Union! Приготовьтесь к очередной порции приключений и страданий, которая поможет вам отточить свои навыки вождения.

Что нас ждет на этот раз? 
Представьте:
Длинная дорога, уходящая за горизонт, где каждый километр – это вызов. Извилистая трасса, требующая максимальной концентрации и мастерства вождения. Усталость, накатывающая равномерно. И, конечно, негабаритный и тяжелый груз за спиной, который нужно доставить точно в срок, несмотря ни на что. 
В этот раз мы приступаем к новому формату проведения мероприятия - самые большие и негабаритные доставки, труднодоступные места разгрузки, нервы, эмоции и гнев. Это не просто поездка, это проверка на прочность, на внимательность, на умение работать в команде. Прочувствуйте каждый момент, каждую деталь, каждую эмоцию. Всё это - обновленный Першерон.
Готовы? Тогда поехали!

ВАЖНО: в обязательном порядке настройте клавиши дифференциала, поднятия и опускания осей как грузовика, так и полуприцепа (трала), переведите кпп в режим 12+2 для использования пониженных передач. Если вы используете VTCBase - отключите усталость... Вам хватит обычных дорожных штрафов. И да прибудет со всеми вами Великий Шварц!

![](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38866.1794243210.jpg)

### Раздача
* **Сбор:** 18:00 (UTC+3)
* **Выезд:** 18:30 (UTC+3)
* **Перерыв:** на каждой дозаправке)
* **Груз:**Кормоуборочный комбайн (forage_harv), 14 т.       
* **Расстояние:** ~ 1830 км
* **Связь:** [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/PuKyGwX7Z4) | Сбор будет происходить в канале #Мероприятия Discord сервера Yukon Union

Для быстрого присоединения к нашему мероприятию, предлагаем вам использовать CargoMan.
* **CargoMan ID: 575575 (ETS2)
DLC: Italia, Vive la France, West Balkans

• Zakaz wyprzedzania (Chyba że Pilot pozwoli)(Nie Dotyczy Pojazdów Eskorty konwoju oraz wspierających konwój Game Moderatorów)
• Obowiązek kulturalnego zachowania wobec innych uczestników konwoju i użytkowników drogi
• Osoby utrudniające konwój mogą zostać ukarane poprzez wykluczenie (czasowe wycofanie z konwoju lub permanętne)
• Zakaz zatrzymywania konwoju bez wyraźnego powodu (np. awarii, problemu technicznego)
• Uczestnicy muszą być gotowi na zmiany trasy lub przerwy wynikające z potrzeb organizatora lub sytuacji na drodze
• Zakaz poruszania się pojazdem typu Scout Extra_D, Scout Extra_D Estate, Public Alternating Vehicle, Patron Alternating Vehicle
• Pojazd Pilota to Scout Extra_D oraz Scout Extra_D Estate w malowaniu Pilota i posiadający Player Tag "PILOT | WładcY SzoS"
• Obowiązują również Zasady panujące na serwerach TruckersMP
• Nieznajomość Regulaminu nie zwalnia z jego przestrzegania
• Niezastosowanie się do Regulaminu oznacza brak szacunku do firmy Organizującej Konwój

Greetings truckers!

This is the EventMK. We will hold a real operations event. This will be the biggest event we hold in a year of development

-----

# EventMK 1st Anniversary (Real Operations V1)
The event will take place on Wednesday, 18th November 2026 between 13:00 - 15:00 UTC. Our employees will work continuously for 2 hours

If you are not sure when you can play in your timezone, make sure to check our [Alternative Time Zones](https://notime.zone/OtAi6VrfJgHtM).


EventMK 1st Anniversary (Real Operations V1) will be held around x cities, including xxx, xxx or xxx
Scope: To be determined (photo)

During EventMK 1st Anniversary (Real Operations V1), you may choose any of the cities in the area of play above. You may also take a job from one city to another inside the area, or use your own trailer if you have one.


All participants are welcome to roam freely inside the highlighted area of play above to allow you to experience any route you may choose! Curious to check an operation again? You can always find a way to go back by safely turning around at a junction or even a roundabout!

-----

# **！！！ First Safety Reminder And Disclaimer ！！！**
Our content includes but is not limited to: Urgent transport, dynamic operations, Heavy cargo transport, and more!
There is a high probability of collisions occurring during the event. As long as this is not something you caused deliberately, we will choose to allow it to happen. Yielding can greatly reduce the likelihood of collisions.
Disclaimer: By attending this Real Operations event, you acknowledge that you may be involved in an incident happening right in front of you.
upcoming.rule:
Event Rules for Participants:
* The Event Staff are recognized as: "EventMK | staff" "EventMK | Media" "EventMK | GM" "EventMK | ES" "EventMK | "
* Participants must yield to all emergency/service vehicles where safe. Here is a useful video explaining how to safely move out of the way for emergency vehicles whilst staying safe: https://youtu.be/Sq_qBijChWk (Takes you to an external site)
* Participants must drive in the EventMK 1st Anniversary (Real Operations V1) "area of play" (Shown on the image above). Driving outside this area will be classed as Free-roaming.
* Participants must haul a trailer.
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Participants should park at their designated slots. If you don't have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
* Cars are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
* Stopping on the emergency lane when it is being used as a live lane is prohibited and will be classed as blocking. If you break down and cannot move off quickly, use F7+Enter to avoid blocking the road.
* All other [TruckersMP](https://truckersmp.com/rules) rules apply.

Event Rules for Event Staff:
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
* Event staff were permitted to maneuver between congested vehicles.
* All other [TruckersMP](https://truckersmp.com/rules) rules apply.

-----

# **！！！ Second Safety Reminder And Disclaimer ！！！**
Our content includes but is not limited to: Urgent transport, dynamic operations, Heavy cargo transport, and more!
There is a high probability of collisions occurring during the event. As long as this is not something you caused deliberately, we will choose to allow it to happen. Yielding can greatly reduce the likelihood of collisions.

upcoming.name: BVAR Trucking November Remembrance Convoy
upcoming.description:
![](https://images.pixieset.com/798473001/8cab5b08face561d90902d672b95992f-xxlarge.png)

### You're invited to join BVAR Trucking November  Rememberance Month convoy.

### Come join us on a scenic tour around the stunning and majestic country of Romania and a brief look around the northern cities of Bulgaria. Your going to be starting off in Bulgaria in the city of **Ruse** taking us west towards **Pleven** and **Kozloduy** before heading northbound into Romania . Here you will be heading north towards **Craiova** continuing the north bound route towards **Hunedoara** where fun and scenic roads will take your eyes. We will be continuing the convoy north east towards **Targu Mures** following the *15* road round onto the *28a*, *28*, *2* and the *11* through **Bacau**, **Brasov** taking us onto the *73* to our final destination of **Pitesti**. 

*While on route you may see many graveyards & churches. As the convoy is in the month of November we will be honouring the fallen and marks the end of WWI On 11th November 1918. So If you see a graveyard feel free to show your respects by giving a little "beep beep"* | *Feel free to use Red/Black into your skin if you wish to as BVAR will be rolling in these colours for the convoy* |
